responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduler model for the original z900 (machine type 2064) in the S/390 backend. It describes that processor’s execution units, instruction reservations, and key bypass/latency rules—especially address-generation hazards via s390_agen_dep_p—for core integer, load/store, branch/call, multiply/divide, and address-forming operations, so GCC’s instruction scheduler can order generic S/390 RTL patterns appropriately when tuning for z900.
